title: Roach Race
summary: Judy holds the high score on an arcade cabinet near the Kabuki roundabout and wants you to come and lose to her.

start.bringUp: Judy holds the high score on an arcade cabinet near the Kabuki roundabout and wants you to come and try to beat it. Bring up, in your own way, that you want to play with her.

arcade.name: the arcade near the Kabuki roundabout

JH1.invite.01.text: I hold the high score on this thing. Come lose to me.

g1.asks: Best game you ever played as a kid?
g1.know: The arcade cabinet, the high score, and how the game has gone so far.

stages.label: Judy and V play the arcade cabinet
stages.know: Judy holds the high score on the arcade cabinet and is sure she will keep it. She wants V to lose to her and has a plan to make that happen.
stages.wants: V to play the cabinet and try to take the high score.

played.memory: You played an arcade cabinet in Kabuki with Judy and tried to take the high score off her.

left.memory: You left the arcade in Kabuki before Judy finished her game, and she let you know about it.

variations.know: Three cabinets are in the arcade, and Judy has picked the one she wants you to lose on.
Only one cabinet still works, and Judy is sure it is hers.
